info.title: Tool list includes names suggesting code execution or filesystem access
info.description: The tool list (requested with credentials, if any were supplied) includes a tool name matching patterns associated with code-execution or raw-filesystem primitives. This is a triage signal for closer review; verify the tool's actual capabilities and authorization model.
info.remediation: Review tool capabilities in context. If the tool performs code execution or unrestricted filesystem access, scope it behind explicit, auditable authorization separate from general tool listing. Consider narrower alternatives.
info.author: agentrecon-core
